description: FraudFeat is a heterogeneous graph of payment accounts, customers, identity records, instruments, and operation events. Node and edge tables use snake_case field names, and relation values use the identifiers in relations[].en. This file defines entity types, fields, enum dictionaries, relation endpoints, stored directions, edge semantics, and companion evaluation files.

conventions.identifiers: Every node has one unique_id. Edge endpoints reference these identifiers.
conventions.storage_direction: Every relation is released as a single directed row set src -> dst. For non-transaction relations the underlying source association is undirected and was folded to one direction (see relations[].undirected). For transaction relations the stored direction records the endpoint the record was filed under, not the direction money moved: in wechat_pay_account_top_up_with_bank_card, wechat_pay_red_packet_funded_by_bank_card, merchant_payment_receipt_payee_side and merchant_refund_payee_side the funds move from dst to src.
conventions.vertex_property_comparison: Vertex properties are compared as strings, e.g. has('state','Deregistered') or has('cre_type','Passport'). Numeric semantics apply only to the edge attributes total_amount, trade_count and top_k.
conventions.amount_unit: total_amount is stored in Chinese renminbi fen (100 fen = 1 yuan).

coverage.description: The transaction relations are source-side pre-aggregated top-eight lists, not a complete transaction log. A counterparty appears only if it entered some endpoint's top-eight list, so degrees in these files are truncated by construction and must not be read as the true number of distinct counterparties.

top_eight_lists.personal_wechat_pay_transfer_payee_side: Each payee contributes at most eight out-edges: its top-eight payers by amount received.
top_eight_lists.personal_wechat_pay_transfer_payer_side: Each payer contributes at most eight out-edges: its top-eight payees by amount sent.
top_eight_lists.merchant_payment_receipt_payer_side: Each merchant contributes at most eight in-edges: its top-eight payers by amount received. Not every member of a merchant's list appears in this file, so ranks are not always contiguous.
top_eight_lists.merchant_payment_receipt_payee_side: Each merchant contributes at most eight out-edges: its top-eight payers by amount received.
top_eight_lists.merchant_refund_payee_side: Each merchant contributes at most eight in-edges: its top-eight refund recipients by amount refunded. Not every member of a merchant's list appears in this file.
top_eight_lists.merchant_refund_payer_side: Each merchant contributes at most eight out-edges: its top-eight refund recipients by amount refunded.
top_eight_lists.wechat_pay_withdrawal_to_bank_card: Per account-and-card aggregate; no top-eight truncation and no published rank.
top_eight_lists.wechat_pay_account_top_up_with_bank_card: Per account-and-card aggregate; no top-eight truncation and no published rank.
top_eight_lists.wechat_pay_red_packet_funded_by_bank_car: Per account-and-card aggregate; no top-eight truncation and no published rank.
top_eight_lists.wechat_pay_account_transfer_to_bank_card: Per account-and-card aggregate; no top-eight truncation and no published rank.

coverage.non_transaction_notes: Non-transaction relations are folded bindings or event links, not aggregates, and are not truncated by rank.

missing_value_policy.description: Some fields carry null and some carry a verbatim sentinel string; the sentinel values below denote missing values.
missing_value_policy.nulls: Fields and edge attributes that can be null carry "nullable": true. Nullable node fields: merchant_pay_account.register_channel, register_status, subject_type, business_scene; individual_customer.last_dereg_time; natural_person.birthday, cre_start_date. Nullable edge attribute: top_k (every row of rel_04, rel_05, rel_06 and rel_09).

sentinels.meaning: The account is not deregistered; exactly the rows with state = Registered carry this value.

node_common_fields.name: unique_id
node_common_fields.description: Globally unique node identifier; see conventions.identifiers.

node_common_fields.name: entity_type
node_common_fields.description: Entity type label; matches the containing entity's entity_type value and is constant within a node file.

edge_common_fields.name: relation
edge_common_fields.description: Snake_case relation identifier; matches relations[].en and is constant within an edge file.

transaction_edge_fields.name: total_amount
transaction_edge_fields.description: Total transaction amount aggregated over trade_count transactions, in Chinese renminbi with unit fen (100 fen = 1 yuan); see conventions.amount_unit. Files that contain a null are stored as float64 in Parquet.

transaction_edge_fields.name: trade_count
transaction_edge_fields.description: Number of transactions aggregated into the edge; at least 1.

transaction_edge_fields.name: top_k
transaction_edge_fields.description: Source-system amount rank inside a top-eight counterparty list; 1 denotes the largest amount in that list. For personal_wechat_pay_transfer_payee_side, top_k is dst's rank among src's top-eight payers by amount received. For personal_wechat_pay_transfer_payer_side, it is dst's rank among src's top-eight payees by amount sent. For merchant_payment_receipt_payer_side and merchant_payment_receipt_payee_side, it has the same meaning in both edge directions: the personal WeChat account's rank among the merchant's top-eight payers by payment amount. For merchant_refund_payer_side and merchant_refund_payee_side, it likewise means the personal WeChat account's rank among the merchant's top-eight refund recipients by refund amount. For wechat_pay_withdrawal_to_bank_card, wechat_pay_account_top_up_with_bank_card, wechat_pay_red_packet_funded_by_bank_card and wechat_pay_account_transfer_to_bank_card, top_k is null for every row. The owning endpoint is also given per relation by relations[].top_k_ranked_within.

An event representing the deletion of a WeChat Pay bill or wallet balance by a personal account.

relations.description: A personal-to-personal WeChat Pay transfer stored from the payee's perspective: src is the account receiving money and dst is one of its payers. Each src row set is that payee's top-eight payer list, and top_k is dst's rank in it by total amount received; 1 denotes the largest amount.

A personal-to-personal WeChat Pay transfer stored from the payer's perspective: src is the account sending money and dst is one of its payees. Each src row set is that payer's top-eight payee list, and top_k is dst's rank in it by total amount sent; 1 denotes the largest amount. Relation 0 and relation 1 are independent row sets drawn from the same transfer population.

A payment received by a merchant, stored on the payer side: src is the personal WeChat payer and dst is the merchant. top_k is the personal payer's rank among dst's (the merchant's) top-eight payers by total payment amount; the rank is owned by dst. Only part of a merchant's list appears in this file, so ranks are not always contiguous.

The same merchant payment population viewed from the payee side: src is the merchant and dst is the personal WeChat payer, so the funds move dst -> src. top_k is dst's rank among src's (the merchant's) top-eight payers by total payment amount.
A withdrawal from a personal WeChat Pay account to a bank card: src is the account, dst is the card, and funds move src -> dst. top_k is null for every row.
A top-up of a personal WeChat Pay account funded by a bank card: src is the account and dst is the funding card, so the funds move dst -> src. top_k is null for every row.
A WeChat Pay red-packet flow funded by a bank card: src is the account and dst is the funding card, so the funds move dst -> src. top_k is null for every row.

A merchant refund stored on the recipient side: src is the personal WeChat refund recipient and dst is the merchant, so the funds move dst -> src. top_k is src's rank among dst's (the merchant's) top-eight refund recipients by total refunded amount. Only part of a merchant's list appears in this file.

The same merchant refund population viewed from the payer side: src is the merchant and dst is the personal WeChat refund recipient, so the funds move src -> dst. top_k is dst's rank among src's (the merchant's) top-eight refund recipients by total refunded amount.
A transfer from a personal WeChat Pay account to a bank card: src is the account and dst is the card, and funds move src -> dst. top_k is null for every row.
A binding between a personal WeChat Pay account and an individual customer record. The source association is undirected and was folded to wechat_pay_account -> individual_customer.
A binding between a personal WeChat Pay account and a natural-person identity, folded to wechat_pay_account -> natural_person.
A bill-deletion event associated with a personal WeChat Pay account, folded to wechat_pay_account -> wechat_pay_bill_deletion_event.
A binding between a personal WeChat Pay account and a phone number, folded to wechat_pay_account -> phone_number.
A binding between a natural-person identity and an individual customer record, folded to natural_person -> individual_customer.
The personal WeChat Pay account is the merchant's super-administrator account, folded to wechat_pay_account -> merchant_pay_account.
A binding between a personal WeChat Pay account and a bank card, folded to wechat_pay_account -> bank_card.
A card-back information query event associated with a personal WeChat Pay account, folded to wechat_pay_account -> wechat_pay_card_back_information_query_event.

labels.description: Fraud labels derived from the risk-source table for all released personal WeChat Pay accounts; every account has exactly one row.

fields.name: unique_id
fields.description: References the unique_id of a personal WeChat Pay account.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Binary fraud label for the referenced account.
